summary: Siuslaw NF lookout: 40-ft pole L-4 built 1934, replaced by 53-ft L-4 in 1948, staffed to 1973, sold and removed 1975; a 1977 emergency-use claim conflicts.

facts.status_note: Sold and removed in 1975 according to three sources. The Former Fire Lookout Sites register says it was used for emergencies in 1977 before removal.

staffing.status: staffed until 1973, the last staffed lookout on the Forest

events.note: 40-ft pole L-4 tower first on the site (register); Oregon Forest Lookouts and ORWW also date a 1934 tower.
53-ft treated timber L-4 tower with 14x14 cab replaced the 1934 tower; bids invited August 1948.
Final year the tower was staffed; last staffed lookout on the Forest (Oregon Forest Lookouts).
Sold for salvage and removed; cab converted into a chicken house by the buyer.
Register says the tower was used for emergencies in 1977 before it was removed. Conflicts with the 1975 removal (see resolved_conflicts).
Registered September 23, 2010, nominated by Ray Kresek (US 675, OR 107).

evidence.supports: first tower was a 40-ft pole L-4 built in 1934
evidence.quote: The first tower on this site was a 40' pole L-4 tower built in 1934.
was constructed in 1934 at Tsp. 14 S., Rng. 10 W., Sec. 15

evidence.supports: May 1934 Register-Guard item: tower to be erected in the Waldport district
evidence.quote: In the Waldport district a tower will be erected on Cannibal mountain.

evidence.supports: August 1948 invitation to bid for a 53-ft prefabricated, treated tower with 14x14 cab
evidence.quote: erect one 53', prefabricated, treated lookout tower, and 14' x 14' cab with catwalk
Bids to be received at this office until 2 p.m., August 23, 1948.

evidence.supports: bid signed by the Acting Forest Supervisor (Forest Service)
53-ft treated timber L-4 tower replaced the first tower in 1948
evidence.quote: This was replaced with a 53' treated timber L-4 tower in 1948.

evidence.supports: staffed until 1973; last staffed lookout on the Forest
evidence.quote: 1973: The final year the tower staffed. This was the last staffed lookout on the Forest.

evidence.supports: sold for salvage and removed in 1975; cab became a chicken house
evidence.quote: 1975: The tower sold for salvage and removed. The cab was converted into a chicken house by the buyer.
The tower was sold and removed in 1975.

evidence.supports: register says used for emergencies in 1977, then removed
evidence.quote: It was used for emergencies in 1977, but has since been removed.

corrections.why: 12.2 m (40 ft) is the 1934 first tower. The 53-ft treated timber L-4 built in 1948 replaced it and is the tower that stood until it was removed in 1975.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the tower was used for emergencies in 1977 before removal. firelookout.com, Oregon Forest Lookouts and the ORWW page say it was gone or sold and removed by 1975. The story follows 1975, the date three or more sources share, and mentions the 1977 claim.

sources.title: Cannibal Mountain Lookout
sources.publisher: Osbornes Project, Oregon Websites and Watersheds Project (orww.org)

notes_for_editor: Four pages read. Build (1934), 1948 replacement, 1973 last staffed year and 1975 removal agree across sources; only the register's 1977 emergency use conflicts. Height corrected from the 40-ft 1934 tower (brief 12.2 m) to the 53-ft 1948 tower that stood until 1975 (16.2 m). Distance: firelookout.com says 22 miles SSE of Newport; Oregon Forest Lookouts quotes an older station description saying about 10 miles airline SE of Waldport. The story uses Newport only. A search snippet listed an Oregon Digital photograph dated 1949-07 (Siuslaw collection) that was not opened, and ORWW holds a 1936 photo caption; licences unchecked, so no photos added. No current-site description or access info found in these pages.
